data.question: Find customers who have placed orders with a total value exceeding $10,000.

WHERE Total_Spending > 10000
RETURN c.Customer_Name AS Customer, Total_Spending
ORDER BY Total_Spending DESC;

WHERE SIZE(Regions) > 1

data.question: Analyze the correlation between order volume and meeting frequency for each Sales Consultant.
data.cypher_query:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:CONDUCTED]->(m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order)
WITH s, COUNT(m) AS Total_Meetings, COUNT(o) AS Total_Orders
RETURN s.Name AS Sales_Consultant, Total_Meetings, Total_Orders, 
       CASE WHEN Total_Meetings > 0 THEN TOFLOAT(Total_Orders) / Total_Meetings ELSE NULL END AS Orders_Per_Meeting
ORDER BY Orders_Per_Meeting DESC;

data.question: Find the products that generate the highest average revenue per order.

RETURN Product, Avg_Revenue
ORDER BY Avg_Revenue DESC;

data.question: Identify customers who have ordered the most diverse range of products.

RETURN s.Name AS Sales_Consultant, ROUND(AvgOrderValue, 2) AS Average_Order_Value, Regions
ORDER BY Average_Order_Value DESC;

data.question: Find the regions where customers place orders predominantly during 9 AM to 12 AM.

data.question: Identify Sales Consultants who conduct the highest percentage of meetings online.

data.question: Retrieve the details (email, contact number, and address) for these consultants: Joseph Duncan, Emily Carter, and Michael Smith.
data.cypher_query: WITH ['Joseph Duncan', 'Emily Carter', 'Michael Smith'] AS ConsultantNames OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales) WHERE s.Name IN ConsultantNames RETURN s.Name AS Name, s.Email AS Email, s.Contact_Number AS Contact_Number, s.Address AS Address;

data.question: Who are the inactive customers for the last 6 months, and when was their last order?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c, MAX(o.Order_Date) AS Last_Order_Date WHERE date(Last_Order_Date) < date() - duration({months: 6}) RETURN c.Customer_Name AS Customer, Last_Order_Date ORDER BY Last_Order_Date ASC;

data.question: Which food products are more likely to have their orders canceled?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.Order_Status = "Cancelled" RETURN p.Product_Name AS Product, p.Category AS Category, COUNT(o) AS Cancellations ORDER BY Cancellations DESC;

data.question: What are the products with the highest average order value (AOV), and how often are they sold?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.Product_Name AS Product, p.Category AS Category, AVG(o.Total_Cost) AS Average_Order_Value, COUNT(o) AS Total_Orders ORDER BY Average_Order_Value DESC;

data.question: What is the revenue distribution for each food category across regions?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN c.Region AS Region, p.Category AS Category, SUM(o.Total_Cost) AS Revenue ORDER BY Region, Revenue DESC;

data.question: Which customers have reduced order frequency compared to the previous year?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c, date(o.Order_Date).year AS Year, count(o) AS OrdersPerYear ORDER BY c.Customer_ID, Year WITH c, collect(Year) AS Years, collect(OrdersPerYear) AS Orders WHERE size(Orders) > 1 AND Orders[-1] < Orders[-2] RETURN c.Customer_Name AS Customer, Years[-2] AS PreviousYear, Orders[-2] AS PreviousOrders, Years[-1] AS CurrentYear, Orders[-1] AS CurrentOrders ORDER BY CurrentOrders DESC;

data.question: What's the relationship between operation centers, order volumes, and cancellation rates?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) WITH o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, COUNT(o) as TotalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as CancelledOrders, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as TotalRevenue, AVG(o.Order_Amount) as AvgOrderSize RETURN Center, TotalOrders, CancelledOrders, ROUND(100.0 * CancelledOrders/TotalOrders, 2) as CancellationRate, TotalRevenue, AvgOrderSize ORDER BY CancellationRate DESC

data.question: I have a customer's phone number (+20 237-274-6238). Can I get their complete information?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE c.Telephone = '+20 237-274-6238' RETURN c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Name, c.Email, c.Address, c.Country, c.Region

data.question: Which customers in Africa have placed orders worth more than 300000 in the last month?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.Region = 'Africa' AND o.Total_Cost > 300000 AND date(o.Order_Date) > date() - duration('P30D') RETURN DISTINCT c.Customer_Name, c.Customer_ID, sum(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Spending ORDER BY Total_Spending DESC

data.question: Show me customers who had meetings but haven't placed orders in the last 30 days?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(m:Meeting) WHERE date(m.Meeting_Date) > date() - duration('P30D') AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE date(o.Order_Date) > date() - duration('P30D') } RETURN DISTINCT c.Customer_Name, c.Customer_ID, c.Email, c.Telephone

data.question: Find all customers in a specific region who haven't updated their contact information (no meetings or orders in 6 months)
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE c.Region = 'Africa' AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE date(o.Order_Date) > date() - duration('P180D') } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(m:Meeting) WHERE date(m.Meeting_Date) > date() - duration('P180D') } RETURN c.Customer_Name, c.Email, c.Telephone, c.Address

data.question: Find the first meeting and first order dates for each customer to analyze acquisition journey
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(m:Meeting), (c)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.Customer_Name, min(m.Meeting_Date) as first_meeting, min(o.Order_Date) as first_order, count(DISTINCT o) as total_orders ORDER BY first_meeting

data.question: Identify customers who have participated in more online meetings than non-online meetings. For each of these customers, provide details including the number of online meetings they attended, the number of non-online meetings they attended, their total number of meetings, the total number of orders they placed, and the total amount they spent on orders. The results should be sorted in descending order based on the number of online meetings.
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(m:Meeting) WITH c, COUNT(CASE WHEN m.Delivery_Type = 'Online' THEN 1 END) AS online_meetings, COUNT(CASE WHEN m.Delivery_Type <> 'Online' THEN 1 END) AS non_online_meetings, COUNT(m) AS total_meetings WHERE online_meetings > non_online_meetings OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.Customer_Name AS CustomerName, online_meetings, non_online_meetings, total_meetings, COUNT(o) AS total_orders, SUM(o.Total_Cost) AS total_spent ORDER BY online_meetings DESC

data.question: Do a Customer Loyalty and Value Analysis. Who are our top 10 customers by order value, and how many meetings have we had with them?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order), (c)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(m:Meeting) RETURN c.Customer_Name, count(DISTINCT o) as order_count, sum(o.Total_Cost) as total_spent, count(DISTINCT m) as meeting_count ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10

data.question: Has 'SC0026' conducted any meetings? If so, with which customers?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales {Sales_Consultant_ID: 'SC0026'})-[:CONDUCTED]->(m:Meeting)<-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]-(c:Customer) RETURN m.Meeting_ID, m.Meeting_Date, m.Meeting_Time, c.Customer_Name

data.question: What is the product information for 'FD0001'?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Product {Product_ID: 'FD0001'}) RETURN p.Product_Name, p.Category

data.question: What are the top 3 most frequently ordered products by customer CUST0005?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer {Customer_ID: 'CUST0005'})-[:PLACED]->(o)-[:CONTAINS]->(p) WITH p, count(p) AS order_count ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.Product_Name, order_count

data.question: Get complete customer profile with exact email 'james_black@example.com'
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer {Email: 'james_black@example.com'}) RETURN c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Name, c.Email, c.Telephone, c.Address, c.Country, c.Region

data.question: Get customer details and their recent orders using exact phone number
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer {Telephone: '+20 237-274-6238'})-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN DISTINCT c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Name, c.Email, c.Telephone, c.Address, c.Country, c.Region, collect(DISTINCT {order_id: o.Order_ID, order_date: o.Order_Date, total_cost: o.Total_Cost}) as recent_orders

data.question: Get customer details for those living in 'GA' (Georgia) - United States
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE c.Address CONTAINS ', GA ' AND c.Address CONTAINS '- United States' RETURN c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Name, c.Email, c.Telephone, c.Address, c.Country, c.Region

data.question: Find customers from Egypt whose name, email, telephone, or address contains the keywords "James," "james," "237," or "Russo." For each of these customers, return their customer ID, name, email, telephone, address, country, and region.
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE (toLower(c.Customer_Name) CONTAINS toLower('James') OR toLower(c.Email) CONTAINS toLower('james') OR c.Telephone CONTAINS '237' OR toLower(c.Address) CONTAINS toLower('Russo')) AND c.Country = 'Egypt' RETURN c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Name, c.Email, c.Telephone, c.Address, c.Country, c.Region

data.question: Find customers whose email contains the keyword "black." For each of these customers, return their customer ID, name, email, telephone, address, country, and region. Additionally, for each customer, list their recent orders (including order ID, order date, and total cost) and recent meetings (including meeting ID, meeting date, and meeting type).
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE c.Email CONTAINS 'black' OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(m:Meeting) RETURN c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Name, c.Email, c.Telephone, c.Address, c.Country, c.Region, collect(DISTINCT {order_id: o.Order_ID, order_date: o.Order_Date, total_cost: o.Total_Cost}) as recent_orders, collect(DISTINCT {meeting_id: m.Meeting_ID, meeting_date: m.Meeting_Date, meeting_type: m.Delivery_Type}) as recent_meetings

data.question: Find customers whose email or telephone contains the keyword "274." For each of these customers, return their customer ID, name, email, telephone, address, country, and region.
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE c.Email CONTAINS '274' OR c.Telephone CONTAINS '274' RETURN c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Name, c.Email, c.Telephone, c.Address, c.Country, c.Region

data.question: Find customers who have placed orders but haven’t had any meetings with consultants.
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE NOT (c)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(:Meeting) RETURN c.Customer_Name, COUNT(o) AS order_count

data.question: Which sales consultants processed orders for customers where the total order cost exceeded 100,000, and what were the corresponding customer names and order totals?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order)<-[:PLACED]-(c:Customer) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 100000 RETURN s.Name, c.Customer_Name, o.Total_Cost

data.question: Which meetings were attended by customers who placed orders with a total cost exceeding 100,000, and what were the meeting details (Meeting ID, Customer Name, Meeting Date, and Meeting Time)?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 100000 OPTIONAL MATCH (m:Meeting)<-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]-(c) RETURN m.Meeting_ID, c.Customer_Name, m.Meeting_Date, m.Meeting_Time

data.question: Get detailed meeting history for consultant with phone ending in '59862'. Include the details of the meeting (Sales Consultant's Name, ID, Meeting Date, Time, Details, Delivery Type), along with the customer’s name and email, and order the results by Meeting Date and Time in descending order.
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales) WHERE s.Contact_Number ENDS WITH '59862' OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:CONDUCTED]->(m:Meeting)<-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]-(c:Customer) RETURN s.Name, s.Sales_Consultant_ID, m.Meeting_Date, m.Meeting_Time, m.Meeting_Details, m.Delivery_Type, c.Customer_Name, c.Email ORDER BY m.Meeting_Date DESC, m.Meeting_Time DESC

data.question: What meetings and orders were associated with the sales consultant whose email is 'donnamarshall@example.com'? Include the customer name, meeting details (date, type, and meeting details), and order details (order ID, order date, and total cost) for each relevant customer, with the results grouped by meetings and orders.
data.cypher_query: MATCH (s:Sales {Email: 'donnamarshall@example.com'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:CONDUCTED]->(m:Meeting)<-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]-(c:Customer) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order)<-[:PLACED]-(c2:Customer) RETURN s.Name, s.Sales_Consultant_ID, collect(DISTINCT { customer_name: c.Customer_Name, meeting_date: m.Meeting_Date, meeting_type: m.Delivery_Type, meeting_details: m.Meeting_Details }) as meetings, collect(DISTINCT { customer_name: c2.Customer_Name, order_id: o.Order_ID, order_date: o.Order_Date, total_cost: o.Total_Cost }) as orders

data.question: Which products are included in order ORD00001?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order {Order_ID: 'ORD00001'})-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.Product_Name, p.Category

data.question: Which Sales Consultant processed the most cancelled orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Status = 'Cancelled' RETURN s.Name AS Sales_Consultant, COUNT(o) AS Cancelled_Orders ORDER BY Cancelled_Orders DESC LIMIT 1

data.question: Which region has the most customers and what are their order details?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c.Region AS Region, COUNT(c) AS Customer_Count, COLLECT(o) AS Orders RETURN Region, Customer_Count, Orders ORDER BY Customer_Count DESC LIMIT 1

data.question: Which Sales Consultant processed the highest number of wholesale orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Type = 'Wholesale' RETURN s.Name AS Sales_Consultant, COUNT(o) AS Wholesale_Orders ORDER BY Wholesale_Orders DESC LIMIT 1

data.question: What is the total revenue generated from orders for each product category?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.Category AS Product_Category, SUM(o.Total_Cost) AS Total_Revenue ORDER BY Total_Revenue DESC

data.question: Which Sales Consultant has the highest customer satisfaction, based on the number of repeat orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order)<-[:PLACED]-(c:Customer) WITH s.Name AS Sales_Consultant, c.Customer_Name AS Customer, COUNT(o) AS Repeat_Orders WHERE Repeat_Orders > 1 RETURN Sales_Consultant, Customer, Repeat_Orders ORDER BY Repeat_Orders DESC

data.question: What is the total number of orders by status?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.Order_Status AS Status, COUNT(*) AS Order_Count ORDER BY Order_Count DESC

data.question: Which operation center has the highest number of cancelled orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Status = 'Cancelled' RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, COUNT(*) as Cancelled_Orders, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Lost_Revenue ORDER BY Cancelled_Orders DESC

data.question: What is the distribution of order types and their average order values?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.Order_Type as Type, COUNT(*) as Order_Count, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Order_Value, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Revenue ORDER BY Order_Count DESC

data.question: Which sales consultants handle the most Direct Supply orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Type = 'Direct Supply' RETURN s.Name as Consultant, COUNT(*) as Direct_Supply_Orders, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Value ORDER BY Direct_Supply_Orders DESC

data.question: What are the peak ordering hours across all centers?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WITH SUBSTRING(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) as Hour, COUNT(*) as Orders_Count RETURN Hour, Orders_Count, toFloat(Orders_Count)/28 as Avg_Orders_Per_Day ORDER BY Hour

data.question: What are the top 5 highest value orders and their details?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN o.Order_ID, o.Order_Date, o.Sysco_Operation_Center, o.Order_Type, o.Total_Cost as Order_Value, p.Product_Name ORDER BY o.Total_Cost DESC LIMIT 5

data.question: What is the average order value by operation center?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, COUNT(*) as Total_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Order_Value, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Revenue ORDER BY Total_Revenue DESC

data.question: Which sales consultants have the highest average order values?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) RETURN s.Name as Consultant, COUNT(*) as Order_Count, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Order_Value, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Sales ORDER BY Avg_Order_Value DESC

data.question: What is the order status distribution for each sales consultant?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) RETURN s.Name as Consultant, o.Order_Status as Status, COUNT(*) as Status_Count ORDER BY s.Name, Status_Count DESC

data.question: Which products have the highest total order amounts?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.Product_Name as Product, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Order_Amount ORDER BY Total_Order_Amount DESC

data.question: What is the average cost per unit by product category?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.Category, AVG(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as Avg_Unit_Cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Product_ID) as Product_Count ORDER BY Avg_Unit_Cost DESC

data.question: Which customers have the highest total order values?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.Customer_Name, COUNT(*) as Order_Count, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Spend ORDER BY Total_Spend DESC LIMIT 10

data.question: What is the distribution of order types by customer region?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.Region, o.Order_Type, COUNT(*) as Type_Count, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Order_Value ORDER BY c.Region, Type_Count DESC

data.question: What is the efficiency of each operation center based on order status?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WITH o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, COUNT(*) as Total_Orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) as Completed_Orders RETURN Center, Total_Orders, Completed_Orders, toFloat(Completed_Orders)/Total_Orders * 100 as Completion_Rate ORDER BY Completion_Rate DESC

data.question: Which operation centers handle the most special orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Type = 'Special Order' RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, COUNT(*) as Special_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Special_Order_Value ORDER BY Special_Orders DESC

data.question: Which operation centers process orders between 22:00 and 06:00?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE toString(o.Order_Time) >= '22:00:00' OR toString(o.Order_Time) <= '06:00:00' RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, COUNT(*) as Night_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Night_Order_Value ORDER BY Night_Orders DESC

data.question: Which customers place high-value orders (>500000) in wholesale category?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 500000 AND o.Order_Type = 'Wholesale' RETURN c.Customer_ID, COUNT(*) as High_Value_Orders, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Value ORDER BY Total_Value DESC

data.question: Find orders with unusually low cost per unit (< 20) but high order amounts (> 2000 units)
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Cost_Per_Unit < 20 AND o.Order_Amount > 2000 RETURN o.Order_ID, o.Cost_Per_Unit, o.Order_Amount, o.Total_Cost, o.Order_Status ORDER BY o.Order_Amount DESC

data.question: What's Center-5's efficiency with Direct Supply orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Sysco_Operation_Center = 'Center-5' AND o.Order_Type = 'Direct Supply' RETURN o.Order_Status as Status, COUNT(*) as Orders, ROUND(AVG(o.Total_Cost)) as Avg_Order_Value, ROUND(AVG(o.Order_Amount)) as Avg_Units ORDER BY Orders DESC

data.question: Find peak hours for high-value orders (>200000) by operation center
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 200000 WITH substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) as Hour, o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, COUNT(*) as Orders RETURN Hour, Center, Orders ORDER BY Center, Orders DESC

data.question: What's the typical processing time window for special orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Type = 'Special Order' WITH toString(o.Order_Time) as OrderTime RETURN CASE WHEN OrderTime >= '09:00:00' AND OrderTime <= '17:00:00' THEN 'Business Hours' WHEN OrderTime >= '17:00:01' AND OrderTime <= '23:59:59' THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Early Morning' END as Time_Window, COUNT(*) as Order_Count ORDER BY Order_Count DESC

data.question: Which sales consultants specialize in handling special orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Type = 'Special Order' WITH s.Sales_Consultant_ID as Consultant, COUNT(*) as Special_Orders, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Value MATCH (s2:Sales {Sales_Consultant_ID: Consultant})-[:PROCESSED]->(o2:Order) WITH Consultant, Special_Orders, Total_Value, COUNT(*) as Total_Orders WHERE Special_Orders >= 2 RETURN Consultant, Special_Orders, Total_Value, ROUND((Special_Orders * 100.0 / Total_Orders), 2) as Special_Order_Percentage ORDER BY Special_Order_Percentage DESC

data.question: Find products with highly variable cost per unit across different orders
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WITH p.Product_ID as Product, AVG(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as Avg_Cost, MIN(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as Min_Cost, MAX(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as Max_Cost, STDEV(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as StDev_Cost WHERE StDev_Cost > 50 RETURN Product, ROUND(Avg_Cost, 2) as Average_Cost, Min_Cost, Max_Cost, ROUND(StDev_Cost, 2) as Standard_Deviation ORDER BY StDev_Cost DESC

data.question: Analyze the relationship between order amount and cost per unit
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) RETURN CASE WHEN o.Order_Amount <= 1000 THEN 'Small Order' WHEN o.Order_Amount <= 3000 THEN 'Medium Order' ELSE 'Large Order' END as Order_Size, COUNT(*) as Order_Count, ROUND(AVG(o.Cost_Per_Unit), 2) as Avg_Cost_Per_Unit, ROUND(AVG(o.Total_Cost), 2) as Avg_Total_Cost ORDER BY Order_Count DESC

data.question: How many orders are placed between 22:00 and 06:00, and what's their completion rate?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) >= '22' OR substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) < '06' RETURN COUNT(*) as Night_Orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as Completion_Rate, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Night_Order_Value

data.question: Which operation centers handle orders over $500,000, and what's their success rate?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 500000 RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center, COUNT(*) as Large_Orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status IN ['Completed', 'Shipped'] THEN 1 END) as Successful_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Large_Order_Value ORDER BY Large_Orders DESC

data.question: What's the price range distribution for Special Orders compared to regular orders, and which operation centers handle orders over $500,000, and what's their success rate?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WITH o, CASE WHEN o.Total_Cost < 50000 THEN 'Low' WHEN o.Total_Cost < 200000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END as Price_Range RETURN o.Order_Type, Price_Range, COUNT(*) as Order_Count, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Value ORDER BY o.Order_Type, Price_Range; OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 500000 RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center, COUNT(*) as Large_Orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status IN ['Completed', 'Shipped'] THEN 1 END) as Successful_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Large_Order_Value ORDER BY Large_Orders DESC

data.question: How do Direct Supply orders compare to Wholesale orders in terms of processing time and value?
data.cypher_query: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Type IN ['Direct Supply', 'Wholesale'] WITH o.Order_Type as Type, CASE WHEN substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) >= '09' AND substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) <= '17' THEN 'Business Hours' ELSE 'Off Hours' END as Timing, o RETURN Type, Timing, COUNT(*) as Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Value, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as Cancellation_Rate ORDER BY Type, Timing

data.question: Which operation centers have the best performance for orders over 3000 units?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Amount > 3000 RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center, COUNT(*) as Large_Volume_Orders, AVG(o.Order_Amount) as Avg_Units, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status IN ['Completed', 'Shipped'] THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as Success_Rate ORDER BY Success_Rate DESC

data.question: Identify operation centers with unusual cost per unit variations
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WITH o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, AVG(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as Avg_CPU, STDEV(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as StDev_CPU RETURN Center, Avg_CPU, StDev_CPU, CASE WHEN StDev_CPU > 50 THEN 'High Variation' WHEN StDev_CPU > 25 THEN 'Medium Variation' ELSE 'Consistent' END as Price_Stability ORDER BY StDev_CPU DESC

data.question: Which sales consultants excel at handling high-volume orders (>2000 units)?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.Order_Amount > 2000 WITH s.Name as Consultant, COUNT(*) as Large_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Value, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status IN ['Completed', 'Shipped'] THEN 1 END) as Successful_Orders WHERE Large_Orders > 3 RETURN Consultant, Large_Orders, Successful_Orders * 100.0 / Large_Orders as Success_Rate, Avg_Value ORDER BY Success_Rate DESC

data.question: What's the relationship between order timing and cancellation rates?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WITH CASE WHEN substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) >= '05' AND substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) < '12' THEN 'Morning' WHEN substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) >= '12' AND substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) < '17' THEN 'Afternoon' WHEN substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) >= '17' AND substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) < '22' THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Night' END as Time_Period, o RETURN Time_Period, COUNT(*) as Total_Orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as Cancellation_Rate, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Order_Value ORDER BY Time_Period

data.question: Which operation centers are most efficient with high-value, low-volume orders?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 200000 AND o.Order_Amount < 2000 RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center, COUNT(*) as Premium_Orders, AVG(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as Avg_Unit_Cost, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Order_Status IN ['Completed', 'Shipped'] THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as Success_Rate ORDER BY Premium_Orders DESC

data.question: Which sales consultants handle the most diverse product categories?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN s.Name as Consultant, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Category) as Category_Count, COLLECT(DISTINCT p.Category) as Categories ORDER BY Category_Count DESC

data.question: How do product categories perform across different order types?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.Category, o.Order_Type, COUNT(*) as Orders, AVG(o.Order_Amount) as Avg_Units, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Revenue ORDER BY p.Category, Orders DESC

data.question: What are the most common special order products in each category?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.Order_Type = 'Special Order' RETURN p.Category, p.Product_Name, COUNT(*) as Special_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Order_Value ORDER BY p.Category, Special_Orders DESC

data.question: Which customers order the most diverse range of products within each category?
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WITH c.Customer_ID as Customer, p.Category as Category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Product_ID) as Unique_Products RETURN Customer, Category, Unique_Products ORDER BY Category, Unique_Products DESC LIMIT 5

data.question: Identify customers who order bakery items but not beverages
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:PLACED]->(o1:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p1:Product) WHERE p1.Category = 'Bakery' OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:PLACED]->(o2:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p2:Product) WHERE p2.Category = 'Beverages' WITH c, COUNT(DISTINCT o1) as Bakery_Orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o2) as Beverage_Orders WHERE Bakery_Orders > 0 AND Beverage_Orders = 0 RETURN c.Customer_ID, c.Customer_Name, Bakery_Orders

data.question: Find operation centers specializing in fresh produce
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE p.Category = 'Produce' WITH o.Sysco_Operation_Center as Center, COUNT(DISTINCT o) as Total_Orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p IS NOT NULL THEN o END) as Produce_Orders WHERE Produce_Orders > 0 RETURN Center, Produce_Orders, Total_Orders, (Produce_Orders * 100.0/Total_Orders) as Produce_Percentage ORDER BY Produce_Percentage DESC

data.question: Analyze sales consultants' performance with high-value orders across categories
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 500000 WITH s, p.Category as Category, COUNT(o) as High_Value_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Order_Value WHERE High_Value_Orders > 0 RETURN s.Name, Category, High_Value_Orders, Avg_Order_Value ORDER BY High_Value_Orders DESC

data.question: Compare product category performance during business vs. non-business hours
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WITH o, p, CASE WHEN substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) >= '09' AND substring(toString(o.Order_Time), 0, 2) <= '17' THEN 'Business Hours' ELSE 'Non-Business Hours' END as Time_Period RETURN p.Category, Time_Period, COUNT(*) as Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Value, SUM(o.Order_Amount) as Total_Units ORDER BY p.Category, Time_Period

data.question: Find customers who consistently order specific product categories
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WITH c, p.Category as Category, COUNT(DISTINCT o) as Order_Count WHERE Order_Count >= 3 RETURN c.Customer_ID, Category, Order_Count, 'Frequent Category Buyer' as Customer_Type ORDER BY Order_Count DESC

data.question: Analyze product category performance by order type
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.Category, o.Order_Type, COUNT(*) as Orders, SUM(o.Order_Amount) as Total_Units, AVG(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as Avg_Unit_Cost ORDER BY p.Category, Orders DESC

data.question: Find sales consultants specializing in specific categories
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sales) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:PROCESSED]->(o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WITH s, p.Category as Category, COUNT(DISTINCT o) as Category_Orders, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Category_Revenue WHERE Category_Orders > 5 RETURN s.Name, Category, Category_Orders, Category_Revenue ORDER BY Category_Revenue DESC

data.question: Analyze order cancellation patterns by product category
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.Order_Status = 'Cancelled' RETURN p.Category, COUNT(*) as Cancelled_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Cancelled_Value, SUM(o.Order_Amount) as Total_Cancelled_Units ORDER BY Cancelled_Orders DESC

data.question: Identify high-value product categories by operation center
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.Total_Cost > 300000 RETURN o.Sysco_Operation_Center, p.Category, COUNT(*) as High_Value_Orders, AVG(o.Total_Cost) as Avg_Order_Value ORDER BY High_Value_Orders DESC

data.question: Analyze product category performance in special orders
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.Order_Type = 'Special Order' RETURN p.Category, COUNT(*) as Special_Orders, AVG(o.Order_Amount) as Avg_Units, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Revenue ORDER BY Special_Orders DESC

data.question: Find customers with diverse category purchasing patterns
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WITH c, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Category) as Category_Count WHERE Category_Count >= 3 RETURN c.Customer_ID, Category_Count, 'Diverse Buyer' as Customer_Type ORDER BY Category_Count DESC

data.question: Analyze product category margins
data.cypher_query: OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.Category, AVG(o.Cost_Per_Unit) as Avg_Unit_Cost, SUM(o.Total_Cost) as Total_Revenue, COUNT(*) as Order_Count ORDER BY Total_Revenue DESC
